name: Demersal fish
description: Bottom-dwelling and semi-demersal fishes. Functional group pooling arrowtooth flounder (about 60% of biomass), walleye pollock, flathead sole, sablefish, skates, Pacific halibut, Pacific cod, rougheye rockfish and others, aggregated from a 1989 PWS trawl survey. The source notes this group is very over-aggregated and includes 10% within-group (cannibalistic) feeding, not shown as an edge here. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
